integrity: Standalone elementary maximum-weight assignment proof and independent small-case checks. The classical matrix exchange lemma and previous quantitative colorful box results are credited. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty families of polyhedra described using the same finite list of facet normals; sharp color count assumes every normal is essential for a bounded full-dimensional polytope. No claim for general convex bodies or infinitely many constraints. Priority of the stronger selection version is provisional.
title: A sharp rainbow-containment theorem for common-normal polytopes
